Yes, that warning is clear enough. It names both bookmarks I'm about to remove, spells out that their saved details and notes will be lost, and gives me "Keep bookmarks" as an easy way to back out — so I know exactly what I'd be destroying and have a safe escape. That's the same careful, deliberate feeling as deleting one, which is just right for something permanent done to several at once.

Having confirmed the warning reads clearly, clicking "Delete 2 permanently" then removes both with a plain "2 bookmarks deleted" confirmation, so there's no doubt it went through. Bulk delete feels appropriately guarded. Happy with it.
